q: In an energy flow diagram a $10\,\text{mm}$ wide arrow enters a device and a useful arrow $3\,\text{mm}$ wide leaves it. How wide is the loss arrow, and what is the efficiency?
a: Energy is conserved, so the outgoing arrows are together as wide as the incoming one: the loss arrow is $10\,\text{mm} - 3\,\text{mm} = 7\,\text{mm}$. The efficiency is $3\,\text{mm} : 10\,\text{mm} = 0.30 = 30\,\%$.
